purpose: Validate closure against separately supplied capture authority; it is not a universal dependency analyzer.
runtime: Node.js 22 or newer, standard library only
review_context: null is allowed during discovery and pre-build; completion requires the current assistant-review scope-manifest, coverage-ledger, snapshot, and requirement mappings.
identity_rules: Capture records base/candidate union edges and required contract/state transitions.
Expected context independently supplies current snapshot, required scope, edges, transitions, verification source identities, and review source mappings.
Completion requires actual verification and exact review projections; discovery completeness remains a caller-reviewed limit.
